report.explanation: Current telemetry shows only 9 retained_heap_after_gc WARN events in order service; gateway, payment, and inventory report successful 200 responses. A short increase in retained-heap warnings alone cannot establish a memory leak, and no evidence ties order memory to checkout degradation. Insufficient evidence for any bounded root cause; handing off.
missing_evidence: Heap usage trend over time for order service to distinguish a leak from transient GC retention
Baseline/expected rate of retained_heap_after_gc warnings for order service
Latency and error-rate metrics for checkout path to confirm the degraded health alert
Evidence linking order-service memory behavior to checkout request failures
